segments.text: Prior to starting work in a BSC, schedule uninterrupted work time if possible and collect all of the laboratory materials that will be needed such as absorbent pads, a biohazard waste container, pipettes, pipette tips, microfuge tubes, a vortex, a small sharps container, paper towels, and whatever else you may need.
segments.zh: 在生物安全柜中开始工作之前，如有可能，安排一段不被打扰的工作时间，并收集好所需的全部实验材料，比如吸水垫、生物危害废物容器、移液器、移液器吸头、微量离心管、涡旋混合器、小型锐器盒、纸巾，以及其他任何你可能需要的东西。

segments.text: Place these materials on a cart next to the BSC.
segments.zh: 把这些材料放在生物安全柜旁边的推车上。

segments.text: A plastic squirt bottle with disinfectant will also be required.
segments.zh: 还需要一个装有消毒剂的塑料挤瓶。

segments.text: For the purposes of this training, we are using a generically labeled disinfectant bottle.
segments.zh: 为了本次培训，我们使用的是一个贴有通用标签的消毒剂瓶。

segments.text: Use and label disinfectants based on OSHA requirements.
segments.zh: 请按照 OSHA 的要求使用消毒剂并贴好标签。

segments.text: For information on labeling and best practices, consult your supervisor or safety office.
segments.zh: 有关标签和最佳做法的信息，请咨询你的主管或安全办公室。

segments.text: First, confirm that the UV light is turned off.
segments.zh: 首先，确认紫外灯已经关闭。

segments.text: Then, check the expiration date on the BSC certification.
segments.zh: 然后，检查生物安全柜认证的有效期。

segments.text: BSCs must be certified when installed, whenever moved, and at least once annually.
segments.zh: 生物安全柜在安装时、每次搬动后都必须认证，而且每年至少认证一次。

segments.text: Next, turn on both the fluorescent light and the blower motor.
segments.zh: 接下来，打开荧光灯和风机。

segments.text: Confirm that the alarm button is on, and open the sash and set it to the proper height, as noted on the outside wall of the BSC.
segments.zh: 确认报警按钮已打开，然后打开前窗，并按照生物安全柜外壁上的标注把它调到正确高度。

segments.text: The BSC sash alarm will sound if the sash is set too high.
segments.zh: 如果前窗设得太高，生物安全柜的前窗报警就会响起。

segments.text: Next, make sure the drain valve handle is perpendicular to the valve body, indicating that it is closed.
segments.zh: 接下来，确保排液阀手柄与阀体垂直，这表示阀门是关闭的。

segments.text: Allow the cabinet to run for at least four minutes in order to purge the air of particulates inside the BSC.
segments.zh: 让安全柜至少运行四分钟，以清除生物安全柜内空气中的颗粒物。

segments.text: If the BSC has a pressure differential gauge, also called a magnahelic gauge, this needs to be checked and recorded.
segments.zh: 如果生物安全柜有压差计，也叫 Magnehelic 压差表，需要检查并记录读数。

segments.text: Compare the reading to what was recorded previously.
segments.zh: 把读数与之前记录的读数进行比较。

segments.text: Gradual changes will generally occur over time due to filter loading, but a sudden change in pressure reading indicates that there is a block or breach of the filter system.
segments.zh: 由于过滤器负荷增加，读数一般会随时间逐渐变化，但压力读数的突然变化表明过滤系统发生了堵塞或破损。

segments.text: Perhaps most important, this reading should never be zero.
segments.zh: 也许最重要的是，这个读数绝不应该为零。

segments.text: If this happens, the BSC should not be used, and you should contact your safety office.
segments.zh: 如果出现这种情况，就不应使用该生物安全柜，你应该联系安全办公室。

segments.text: Some labs keep a pressure gauge log taped on the BSC and record the daily readings.
segments.zh: 有些实验室会在生物安全柜上贴一份压力表记录表，记录每天的读数。

segments.text: That way, you can see quickly if there has been a significant change from the previous day.
segments.zh: 这样你就能快速看出与前一天相比是否有明显变化。

segments.text: Inward airflow should be verified prior to use.
segments.zh: 使用前应确认存在向内气流。

segments.text: You can use a smoke generator, or you can tape a tissue to the bottom of the sash.
segments.zh: 可以使用烟雾发生器，也可以在前窗底部贴一张纸巾。

segments.text: The tissue should be drawn into the cabinet to show inward airflow.
segments.zh: 纸巾应该被吸向柜内，表明存在向内气流。

segments.text: Once the cabinet has been running for at least four minutes, gather the necessary supplies for decontamination and place them inside the BSC.
segments.zh: 安全柜运行至少四分钟后，把去污所需的物品收集起来放进生物安全柜。

segments.text: Decontaminate the inside using an appropriate liquid disinfectant that has been approved as effective against the infectious agents you are working with and has been designated in your laboratory SOP.
segments.zh: 用合适的液体消毒剂对柜内进行去污，这种消毒剂应已被证实对你所操作的感染性病原体有效，并在你们实验室的 SOP 中有指定。

segments.text: Clean all of the surfaces with the liquid disinfectant and disposable towels.
segments.zh: 用液体消毒剂和一次性纸巾清洁所有表面。

segments.text: This includes the sidewalls, the back wall, the inside of the glass on the sash, and the work surface.
segments.zh: 包括侧壁、后壁、前窗玻璃的内侧以及工作台面。

segments.text: It is not recommended to spray disinfectant inside the BSC because the mist can be drawn internally into the grills or HEPA filter,
segments.zh: 不建议在生物安全柜内喷洒消毒剂，因为雾滴可能会被吸入格栅或 HEPA 过滤器内部，

segments.text: and this can cause pitting of the stainless steel parts inside the BSC, or it can cause damage to the HEPA filter.
segments.zh: 这可能导致生物安全柜内的不锈钢部件产生点蚀，或者损坏 HEPA 过滤器。

segments.text: It is better to generously moisten the towel and wipe the surfaces, allowing enough contact time for the disinfectant to do its job.
segments.zh: 更好的做法是把纸巾充分润湿后擦拭表面，并留出足够的接触时间让消毒剂发挥作用。

segments.text: Contact time will vary depending on what is being used.
segments.zh: 接触时间因所用消毒剂而异。

segments.text: Discard the used towels into the biohazard waste bag.
segments.zh: 把用过的纸巾丢进生物危害废物袋。

segments.text: Don't ever put your head inside a BSC.
segments.zh: 千万不要把头伸进生物安全柜内。

segments.text: If you can't reach the back wall, use an extendable mop and then discard the used disposable mop cloth into the biohazardous waste container.
segments.zh: 如果够不到后壁，可以使用伸缩拖把，然后把用过的一次性拖把布丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: If bleach has been used as a disinfectant, wipe the BSC surfaces again with water or 70% ethanol to remove any bleach residue.
segments.zh: 如果使用漂白剂作为消毒剂，要再用水或 70% 乙醇擦拭生物安全柜的表面，以去除残留的漂白剂。

segments.text: This is because bleach is corrosive and can pit the stainless steel, which can provide an ecological niche or environment for microorganisms to evade cleaning and disinfection.
segments.zh: 这是因为漂白剂有腐蚀性，会使不锈钢产生点蚀，而点蚀会为微生物提供一个生态位或环境，使其逃过清洁和消毒。

segments.text: Once you have completed disinfection of the BSC, dispose of your gloves in the biohazard waste container.
segments.zh: 完成生物安全柜的消毒后，把手套丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: The stool or bench should be adjusted to ensure that your face is above the sash opening and that your armpits are level with the bottom of the sash.
segments.zh: 应调整凳子或座椅，确保你的脸位于前窗开口上方，腋窝与前窗底部齐平。

segments.text: As a reminder to perform these tasks, a BSC checklist may be used according to your lab's protocol.
segments.zh: 为了提醒自己完成这些工作，可以按照实验室的规程使用生物安全柜检查清单。
